title: Ty Masterson details campaign stops as part of pre-election barnstorm tour across Kansas
text:
Government
Ty Masterson details campaign stops as part of pre-election barnstorm tour across Kansas
Kansas State Senator Ty Masterson shared multiple updates on October 28th about his ongoing barnstorming campaign tour leading up to Election Day.
Ty Masterson, a Kansas state senator, has been actively sharing updates on his statewide barnstorm tour ahead of the 2026 Election Day. On October 28, 2026, Masterson posted several messages on his X (formerly Twitter) account highlighting stops in Leavenworth and Atchison and emphasizing key campaign themes.
In a post from the early hours of October 28, Masterson announced the start of his tour: "Our Kansas barnstorm tour before Election Day is officially underway, and we kicked things off in Leavenworth, the First City in Kansas! Over the coming days, we’ll be traveling across the state, meeting with Kansans, and talking about the future we’re building. It’s been an https://t.co/6tGNs782ug".
Later that day, Masterson underscored the urgency of the election cycle: "6 DAYS UNTIL ELECTION DAY! We're in the final stretch, Kansas, and the stakes couldn't be higher. For months, we've traveled across our great state talking about lower taxes, safer communities, stronger schools, and making Kansas more affordable for working families. Now,".
By evening on October 28, Masterson highlighted engagement with young voters during another campaign stop: "Another great stop on our Barnstorming Tour in Atchison! It was especially encouraging to see students from Benedictine College come out and get involved in the conversation about Kansas' future. With Election Day just six days away, we're continuing to travel across the state,".
Kansas is set to hold its general elections in November 2026. Ty Masterson currently serves as President of the Kansas Senate. His campaign focuses include lowering taxes for residents of Kansas and prioritizing public safety and education—issues frequently at the center of state-level political debates.
